% caption (Title Case): \caption{Populism and Liberalism in Party Manifestos over Time, by Ideology}
\par\smallskip\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Mean overall populism (left panel) and mean overall liberalism (right panel), 0--10, of the manifestos in each five-year period from 1960 on (the last period is 2020--2025), plotted at the middle of the period, with 95 percent confidence intervals (mean $\pm$ 1.96 standard errors). Left: manifestos with an ideology score $(R-L)/(R+L) \le 0$; right: ideology score $> 0$. Lines connect the period means; no smoothing. Sample: 3,147 manifestos with populism, overall liberalism and ideology scores, elections from 1960 on.\end{minipage}
